specificSetting: the civic role of libraries planning brief 3

tasks.scenario: Two source texts debating whether libraries should expand their civic role beyond traditional knowledge provision.
tasks.audience: Educated general reader (English teacher as assessor)
tasks.purpose: Synthesise competing claims, evaluate assumptions, and develop an independent position on the civic role of libraries.
requiredContentPoints: the main public libraries issue (expanded role vs core mission)
one practical consequence (e.g., resource strain or increased community value)
a justified recommendation (how to balance roles)
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Source texts present contrasting views on library evolution; no reuse of previous essay topics (education, transport, exchange visits). Forbidden concepts avoided.

tasks.scenario: Review of an innovative library initiative for a specialist magazine.
tasks.purpose: Assess effectiveness of a library initiative and recommend adoption by other libraries.
requiredContentPoints: the main public libraries issue (initiative aims and community impact)
one practical consequence (effectiveness of the initiative)
a justified recommendation (whether to adopt similar approach)
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Review genre with library-specific context; no overlap with previous review tasks (book, documentary, workshop). Forbidden concepts avoided.

tasks.scenario: Report on library usage patterns and civic engagement for a foundation.
tasks.purpose: Analyse implications of changing usage patterns and propose actions to strengthen civic role.
requiredContentPoints: the main public libraries issue (declining borrowing vs demand for non-traditional services)
one practical consequence (impact on civic engagement)
a justified recommendation (actions to balance roles)
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Report genre with library focus; no reuse of previous report scenarios (jobs fair, decision autonomy, transport access). Forbidden concepts avoided.

tasks.scenario: Article for an online magazine arguing a position on the future of public libraries.
tasks.purpose: Explain a position on library priorities and request engagement with the argument.
requiredContentPoints: the main public libraries issue (traditional vs civic mission)
a justified recommendation for future approach
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Article genre with library theme; no reuse of previous article topics (travel, learning, transport). Forbidden concepts avoided.

The review, report, and article tasks have unique lead-ins and required content. The test is structurally original and level-appropriate.
